title: Concept: Lockfile drops a dependency's own requirements
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry that records no dependency requirements where the package declares some, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The transitive surface disappears from the lockfile, so the tree that installs is larger than the tree the review read.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The transitive surface disappears from the lockfile, so the tree that installs is larger than the tree the review read.
